name: Valdeobispo (Spain)
description: Five equal vertical stripes of blue, white, red, white and blue.
history: The arms and the flag of Valdeobispo were approved by the Order of 1 December 1992 of the Consejería de Presidencia y Trabajo published in the Diario Oficial de Extremadura on 2 January 1993, after the municipal council's approval on 29 July 1992; the flag is rectangular of 2:3, formed of five equal vertical stripes, blue at the edges, white between and red in the centre.
